name: add-slide
description: Add a new slide at the end of the front Keynote document with a title and body text

steps.script:
tell application "Keynote"
    tell front document
        set newSlide to make new slide at end of slides
        tell newSlide
            set object text of default title item to "New Slide Title"
            set object text of default body item to "Bullet point content"
        end tell
        return "Added slide " & (slide number of newSlide) & " with title"
    end tell
end tell
